title: pseuderucaria clavata subsp. tourneuxii
intro: Pseuderucaria clavata subsp. tourneuxii, commonly known as Tourneux's Pseuderucaria, is a plant species in the Borage family (Boraginaceae). It is a flowering plant that has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions such as wound healing and infections. The bioactive constituents of Tourneux's Pseuderucaria include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
